title: XML resolver left enabled on a document parser in csharp — review required
description: Setting XmlResolver on XmlDocument or XmlReader re-enables external entity and DTD resolution, so a crafted document can read local files or make server-side requests during parsing. Modern .NET defaults it to null for this reason. The rule flags the assignment; whether the document is untrusted is a review decision.
remediation: Keep XmlResolver null, set DtdProcessing.Prohibit and never resolve external resources for untrusted XML.
limitation: Lexical: matches an explicit XmlResolver assignment; a resolver configured through a reader settings object is out of scope.
